title: Browser slow, clear cache and tabs

character.name: Aiman
character.personality: chatty, keeps lots of tabs open

symptom: Web browser has become very slow
user_description: My browser is so slow, pages take forever to load. I always have loads of tabs open. Is the internet down?

options.text: Install a different browser from a random site
options.why: Unsafe and unapproved. Downloading from unknown sites risks malware.
Expensive and unrelated. Other websites and devices are not mentioned as slow.

options.text: Close unneeded tabs, restart the browser, and clear the cache and cookies after warning her she will be signed out of sites
options.why: Many open tabs use a lot of memory, and an overloaded cache can slow a browser. Warning about sign-outs avoids surprises.

hints: How many tabs does she have open, and what does each one use?
What would happen to saved logins if you cleared cookies?
real_world_tip: Check whether other devices on the same network are also slow. That tells you if it is the browser or the connection.
